description: This file defines the LambdaClient class for interacting with AWS Lambda, extending AwsClient, and contains method definitions and middleware configuration specific to AWS Lambda API.

classes.name: LambdaClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Lambda service, providing methods to invoke Lambda functions and manage configurations, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LambdaClient and adds default curl options middleware if the curl extension is loaded.

methods.name: getDefaultCurlOptionsMiddleware
methods.description: Provides middleware that injects default curl options into commands, such as enabling TCP keepalive.
